lines.label: Market rent
lines.note: CMHC October 2025, 26 units; some unit types priced at the CMHC all-units average: the table has no figure for them

lines.note: 30% of an income of 70% of the Housing Income Limit (Vancouver), the way BC Housing's call documents estimate it: $1,015 a month for one bedroom or less, $1,260 for two, $1,505 for three; an estimate, so enter the operator's own rent when there is one

lines.note: the income assistance shelter allowance, $500 a month for one bedroom or less and $695 for two; $769 for three, 30% of the deep-subsidy income limit

lines.note: $600 per unit

lines.note: none entered

lines.label: Net operating income

lines.label: Equity
lines.note: none entered

lines.label: Supportable debt
lines.note: the largest loan the net operating income carries: the lender wants net income 1.10 times the loan payment (the debt coverage ratio), at 6.19% repaid over 40 years (the amortization), $627,855 a year in payments

lines.label: Funding
lines.note: grants + equity + supportable debt

lines.label: Gap
lines.note: capital cost less funding; a negative gap is headroom, and a gap above the 15% line (this tool's screening line, not a funder's rule) of the capital cost reads Needs more sources
